claims.statement: For r>=2, independent original-coordinate cap-one U,V, invertible B, and Q=F(U,Z)+2U^T B V+c(Z)^T V, Q has a continuous density and ||p_Q||_inf <= C_r |det B|^{-1/r}, C_r=r^(3/2) omega_r^(1/r)/(2(r-1)).
If disjoint original coordinate sets P,T have |P|=|T|=r>=2, A[T,T]=0 and det A[P,T]!=0, then ||p_{X^TAX}||_inf <= C_r |det A[P,T]|^{-1/r}, with continuous density.
The same bound holds as a geometric interval slab inequality for arbitrary unit-measure product sets and transfers with zero loss to all cap-one product laws using account04/B13 purification.

limitations: Exact nullity A[T,T]=0 is essential to the stated theorem; no perturbative near-null deletion is claimed.
The theorem is a branch theorem and does not establish the full three-large-eigenvalue conjecture.
